title: Stop loading known-safe options on every request

prefixes.description: Option name prefixes eligible to stop autoloading. Values given here can only narrow the operation's own allowlist, never widen it.

minimum_bytes.description: Only options at least this large are worth changing.

description: Marks a small set of known-safe options so WordPress stops loading them into memory on every single request. Nothing is deleted and no value changes; only the flag that decides whether an option is read eagerly. Options outside the allowlist are never touched, however large they are.
